newsitem.title: USA: Icahn says RJR must spin off Nabisco.
newsitem.headline: Icahn says RJR must spin off Nabisco.

text.p: Investor Carl Icahn on Monday pressed RJR Nabisco Holdings Corp to spin off its Nabisco Holdings Corp unit immediately, saying RJR's stock price has lost over 20 percent recently and lost market share to rival Philip Morris Cos Inc.
Icahn, who holds a 7.3 percent stake or 19.93 million common shares of RJR, made his latest request on the matter in a letter to RJR chairman Steven Goldstone in a letter on Monday.
A copy of the letter was attached to a filing with the Securities and Exchange Commission.

Icahn also said he has formed a slate of directors he will nominate to the RJR board. The slate will be headed by Thomas Rattigan, former chief executive officer of PepsiCo Bottling International and former chairman of G. Heileman Brewing Co.
